statements.status_notes: Microsoft.OpenApi.Readers 1.6.19 is a prebuilt .NET assembly shipped inside the @kiota-community/kiota-wasm@0.0.3 WebAssembly bundle. The NuGet packages within that bundle cannot be upgraded independently; a fix requires upstream kiota-wasm to publish a new release embedding patched assemblies. Investigation is ongoing.
